physical_properties.evidence: scalar drag and damping defaults are numerical regularizers; body-axis drag coefficients and rotor polar inertia are unmeasured and remain unknown

motor_propeller.propeller_geometry_source: 3D repository kilo branch at d591b81bd671e04abe7d4bdeb0865fd3c3bf381b; cad/parametric/model.params.json and output/smooth2-parametric/assembly-manifest.json. Custom two-blade parametric propeller design; geometry is not a measured thrust/torque curve.
motor_propeller.evidence: Catalog identity and limits partially characterized from multiple vendor sources; exact manufacturer/lot and exact motor+ESC+battery+propeller bench calibration remain unknown.
motor_propeller.catalog_data_note: Sourced values from multiple A2212/13T vendors; exact user's motor identity is not verified. Conflicting values are preserved with source attribution in vehicle_models/components/a2212_1000kv_motor.json. Catalog values do not replace bench measurements.

synthetic_software_test_values.warning: Only enabled by an explicit software-only flag. Never use for physical predictions or real flight.

required_before_physical_calibration: weigh the complete takeoff aircraft including battery and payload
measure CG in the declared CAD_EXPORT_Z_UP frame
calculate full inertia tensor from validated solids and verified material densities, then cross-check experimentally where practical
identify exact motor, ESC, battery and propeller combination
obtain or measure thrust, torque, RPM, voltage and current data over the operating range
verify rotor spin directions and motor numbering

motor_reference.note: Catalog no-load current is available for a generic A2212 vendor reference, but exact motor identity is not verified; it is intentionally not injected into the simulation.

electrical_model.simulation_policy: Estimate shaft-power-derived current/energy telemetry only. Do not apply battery voltage sag or current limiting until exact pack resistance and ESC limits are measured.
